svg.text: Finite peak–saddle domain correspondence · frozen 96×96 B|E
Boundary outlines are finite domains only; pale gray is E. Colors identify lobes within a panel, not across time. Gold dot marks greatest-contrast control.
Matrices include every nonzero domain overlap; axes include every finite lobe. Pair values remain exact in domain-audit.json.gz.
